title: One error descriptor has envelope and Problem Details projections
decision:
- `application/json` keeps the current envelope and adds descriptor fields plus
  `meta.correlation_id`.
- `application/problem+json` projects the same descriptor/meta into RFC 9457.
- Stable code/category/path/retryability/detail keys are identical in both forms;
  human message/detail text is not a compatibility key.
- HTTP status is projection-only. `Retry-After` requires named duration policy;
  retryable boolean alone is insufficient.
- Error catalogue remains P12 fixture + descriptors; no second Problem Details list.
rationale:
Replacing the envelope would break current clients; omitting Problem Details would
lose standard tooling. Two projections over one descriptor preserve both without
dual semantic ownership.

sections.text:
**Actor:** plan-designer/codex-gpt-5.6-sol/high
**Evidence:** RAG:✅ RFC 9457 permits extension members and keeps human detail
non-machine-readable. D60–D61 assign descriptor ownership to P12 and wire ownership
to P13.

sections.title: Почему

sections.title: Consequences
sections.text:
P13.9 owns negotiation/serializer/OpenAPI. P13.10 emits one `errors.json` from the
P12 fixture, and P13.12 proves parity.
